changeSet.author: gateway
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE audit_log (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, action VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, user_id UUID, username VARCHAR(64), ip_address VARCHAR(64), details TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_created_at ON audit_log(created_at DESC);

changeSet.author: gateway
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION audit_log_immutable() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'audit_log is immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

changeSet.author: gateway
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_log_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_log_immutable();
